title: Kombat Teams
wikitext:
Game mod used in the end of 90's, predecessor of [[KTPro]] and [[KTX]] mods.

From the original Kombat Teams documentation: ''Kombat Teams is a QUAKEWORLD ONLY patch by kemiKal_sWeMoB, Cenobite and Fang which means to simplify all forms of deathmatch games (1-1, 2-2, 4-4, 3-3-3, 31-1 etc.).''

It was the mod which added commands like ready, break, stats, effi, dm, tp, spawn, status, whonot, scores, overtime, admin, join, k_nick, gender, report.

Introduced new [[Spawn modes]] and [[Fallbunny]].
